docstring:
Summary:  
Layouts the ShellWindowFrameView by positioning the close button.

Parameters:  
None

Returns:  
None

Logic:  
The function first checks if the window is frameless; if so, it exits early. It then retrieves the preferred size of the close button and calculates its vertical and horizontal offsets based on the caption height, ensuring the button is centered within the frame.
